scope: Known-latent frozen bulk-law transfer on development dynamics. Analytic-law trajectory shares an unqualified discretization; it is not independent ground truth. No physical inference or native-framework superiority claim.

metrics.rms_definition: Positive-point-weighted vector RMS, not coordinate RMS or full consistent-FEM mass norm; uniform recorded-frame aggregation including initial frame.
metrics.weight_scope: Caller-supplied positive point weights; with nodal mass row sums this is a lumped-node diagnostic. COM is computed from the same specified weights.
metrics.alignment_scope: Proper rigid alignment only for shape error and deformation census; world errors unchanged.
metrics.aggregation_scope: Common available prefix only; failed full trajectory retained
